['run the evaluate.py CLI to evaluate video caption predictions against ground truth references using tIoU thresholds', 'run the ANETcaptions class evaluate method to compute CIDEr, BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, and SPICE scores across tIoU thresholds', 'run the evaluate_detection method to compute temporal precision and recall for predicted video event timestamps', 'run the evaluate_tiou method to compute caption quality scores at a specific temporal IoU threshold', 'run the remove_nonascii function to strip non-ASCII characters from caption text before evaluation']
